display.purpose: Sign/display labels, headings, lot labels, and prominent metrics; local OFL-licensed font.

coordinate.purpose: Plan coordinates and compact location data.

components.name: Destination band and search
components.description: Broad yellow wayfinding band containing a dark vehicle search field.
components.css: .ds-destination-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .8fr) minmax(240px, 1.2fr); align-items: center; gap: 13px; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 13px; color: #11151b; background: #f5c400; border: 1px solid #f5c400; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-destination-band label { font: 800 20px/1 'Barlow Condensed', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; color: #f5c400; background: #11151b; border: 1px solid #11151b; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-search-field svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search-field input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #fff; background: transparent; } .ds-search-field:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #11151b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Compact horizontal navigation
components.description: Horizontal top rail with a yellow active Patio item.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 3px; color: #d4d9de; font: 800 14px/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #252e39; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5c400; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #f5c400; color: #11151b; }

components.name: Compact metric strip
components.description: Inline summary figures with dividers, subordinate to the six-lot plan.

components.css: .ds-stats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0; padding: 3px 0; border-block: 1px solid #414950; } .ds-stat { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; padding: 0 13px; border-right: 1px solid #414950; color: #c0c7cf; font: 400 10px/1.4 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-stat strong { color: #f3f4f6; font: 800 14px/1 'Barlow Condensed', Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat:first-child strong { color: #50df91; }

components.name: Six-lot plan selection
components.description: Dark gridded plan; green locates vehicles and yellow distinguishes the selected vehicle.
components.css: .ds-yard-viewport { border: 1px solid #59636d; border-radius: 2px; background-color: #1b222b; } .ds-yard-car { color: #50df91; } .ds-yard-car[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #f5c400; } .ds-yard-car[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-yard-bay { fill: #f5c40028; stroke: #f5c400; stroke-width: 2.4; } .ds-yard-coordinate { fill: #c7d4ce; font: 12px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Selected vehicle card
components.description: Squared high-contrast yellow sign for existing read-only vehicle detail.
components.css: .ds-vehicle-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #f5c400; border-radius: 2px; color: #11151b; background: #f5c400; } .ds-vehicle-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 800 20px/1.1 'Barlow Condensed', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-vehicle-card dl > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin: 8px 0; } .ds-vehicle-card dt { color: #37320f; } .ds-vehicle-card dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Patio is a wayfinding system for locating a specific vehicle, not a fleet dashboard. The six-lot plan is the destination; the selected vehicle's lot and coordinates become an unmistakable sign. This documents the selected direction for the new /ui Patio system. interfaz.html legacy configuration and processing remain untouched and retain their previous system; these tokens do not apply to legacy.
keyCharacteristics: Terminal wayfinding: charcoal ground, durable white labels, and a broad signal-yellow destination band.
Green means a confirmed located vehicle; yellow means destination, action, or selection.
Compact horizontal navigation and metric strip keep the six-lot plan dominant.

rules.name: State-Color Rule
rules.body: Keep yellow for destination/action/selection and green for located state; do not use them interchangeably.

rules.name: Legacy Boundary
rules.body: Patio /ui tokens apply only to Patio; interfaz.html configuration and processing retain their previous system.

dos: Do keep the six-lot plan primary and the metric strip secondary.
Do preserve visible focus and the compact squared wayfinding language.
Do keep Patio tokens scoped to /ui.
donts: Don't infer dispatch availability from empty positions or imply viewing reserves a vehicle.
Don't use yellow and green interchangeably.
Don't apply Patio styling to legacy interfaz.html configuration or processing.
